HyperX Cloud Jet Wireless Gaming Headset (2.4GHz Low-Latency Wireless / 40mm Dynamic Drivers / Up to 19 Hours Battery Life / Flip-to-Mute Noise-Canceling Mic / Lightweight Design / Multi-Platform Compatibility)

Cut the cord and experience seamless audio freedom with the HyperX Cloud Jet Wireless Gaming Headset, available at Turbo Computer Egypt. Engineered for high-speed gaming audio, this headset features a low-latency 2.4GHz wireless connection with up to 19 hours of battery life on a single charge. Powered by custom-tuned 40mm dynamic drivers, it delivers clear positional sound and punchy bass for competitive advantage. Designed with comfortable memory foam ear cushions, a flip-to-mute noise-canceling microphone, and intuitive fast-access volume controls, it provides effortless audio management across PC and console platforms.
